vars.name: ss-m-fenrir
vars.tags: nordic folk metal, deep male chanting vocals, war drums, tagelharpa, throat singing, epic, dark, 100 bpm
vars.lyrics:
[verse]
Bound in the dark by the chains of the gods
Fenrir is waiting, he counts every dawn
[chorus]
Break, break the chain
When the wolf runs free the sky will burn
Break, break the chain
Ragnarok is coming for us all
